comparison.objective: Candidate configures a gripper opening stop; PR-2198 divides a dough log into four portions at marked locations.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate tests coaxial driver/wrench torque control; PR-2198 tests vertical scraper alignment, controlled chopping through compliant material, and avoiding drag or incomplete cuts.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires a locked 90° opening retained over three cycles; PR-2198 requires three complete cuts at marks, four ordered pieces, no creases or loss, tools down, and hands clear.
comparison.reason: The cutting and portioning outcome is unrelated to adjustable-stop locking and cycle verification.
